summary: A smitten lover tells his partner she makes him feel alive and that he cannot get enough of her.
A bold rapper boasts about her sexual confidence, money and status while dismissing exes, rivals and imitators.
A woman gushes over a devoted partner, promising to spend hours loving him and celebrating their romance.
A cowboy recalls a beach fling that never called back, returning to Tennessee with only sand in his boots.
A woman tells a toxic ex to stay away, tosses his number and vows never to take him back.
A dad jokes about dodging trouble and keeping family and sobriety on track.
Two women boast about a steamy ride with a lover and promise him a taste of their sweetest pie.
A woman texts an old flame suggesting a night of reminiscing, weed and driving around before she leaves town tomorrow.
After a rocky year and a breakup, the singer celebrates getting back on her feet and dancing.
A man marvels that God made the perfect woman, since whiskey and trucks could never explain how she loves him.
Doja Cat brags about her drip and sexual confidence, taunting others and brushing off judgment and gossip.
A man feels high on a woman he desires, calling her his drug and feeling perfect amid the chaos.
A man agonizes over a rocky relationship after a painful midnight breakup in Austin, weighing whether to fight for it.
A singer imagines life without music and insists he would still play for crowds, because performing is his calling.
A woman admits a new romance is wrong but craves the fun, torn between heaven and hell.
A lonely man waits for better days, bragging about his wealth and lifestyle while longing for someone to hold him.
A restless night owl begs his partner to meet at their secret spot after drunk texts and late drives.
A woman regrets the time and advice she gave an ex who she now realizes never truly loved her.
A woman relives a painful autumn romance in full detail, remembering the love and the ex who ended it.
Partygoers chase a night of dancing, flirting and after-parties, indulging desire and bravado without caring what others say.
A flirtatious man invites a woman to keep the beach party going in his bed, teasing rivals and boasting.
A man gently tells a lover to leave before temptation wins, admitting the desire but choosing restraint.
A man warns himself that Broadway girls only love him for the moment, so he should stay home.
A man proposes to a new love, saying he is done waiting and wants her to take his name.
Two rappers recall street loyalty and betrayal, mourning a friend lost to violence and boasting about wealth and survival.
Future brags about flying high on drugs and luxury, flashing wealth and cars while dismissing rivals and spending freely.
A singer tells his lover he loves her as much as country music, comparing her to classic songs and legends.
A festive dance song celebrates a bright winter night of jingle bells, sleigh rides and frosty, rocking fun.
A man falls for a woman with beautiful eyes, feeling reborn and choosing love over caution in a passionate romance.
The singer warns that heartbreak lingers, leaving a man drinking whiskey and driving at midnight, unable to forget her.
A cheerful holiday wish urges listeners to enjoy Christmas, greet friends and kiss someone under the mistletoe.
A man lists romantic gestures his partner loves, from pouring tequila to playing John Denver and dimming the lights.
A couple keeps coming back together despite the drama, admitting they always end up together no matter what they promise.
A heartbroken man cannot bear to hear his favorite singer's song since his lover left, and the hurt only grows.
A jealous narrator envies a rival who has everything, fearing her boyfriend will leave for the glamorous girl.
A lonely man at a bar hopes tonight brings a new love and an end to drinking alone.
A man in crisis begs a florist for roses to win back his wife, admitting he wrecked their life.
A London rapper hypes a rave, bragging about his crew and cash while promising a girl the moon.
A gossipy tale of a married man sneaking off for a steamy affair and luxury gifts.
Two lovers keep sliding back together despite swearing they are through, meeting late at bars for whiskey and kisses.
A struggling songwriter recalls moving to Tennessee with a broken car, chasing a hit with the pedal down.
After a drunken fight a couple splits, but he insists their story is not over yet.
A newly independent woman declares she can love herself better than an ex, buying her own flowers and dancing alone.
A woman fantasizes about killing her ex and his new partner after catching them together, admitting she still loves him.
The singer admits she is her own worst problem, a self-doubting anti-hero who keeps pushing loved ones away with scheming.
A man begs his partner to keep any cheating secret while rappers shout out their crews.
A man urges a woman to relax at a party, admitting attraction and the pull of love as they dance.
A strained couple reaffirms their love, with him vowing he would die for her no matter what.
A woman recalls escaping a hard life in a fast car, dreaming of a future that never arrives.
A woman swears she cannot lose with her partner, joking about being his main one amid sex and loyalty.
